decision.summary: No temporary offset intervals confirmed or uncertain within allowed_context [455,579]. The E-component ramp (490–544) is gradual with increasing slope and no opposing return; N and U show no coherent matching transient. The later coupled E-upward/U-downward trend (starting ~520) extends beyond the allowed context and lacks a return within [455,579]. All observed features are smooth, sustained trends without clear onset-return pairs required for temporary offsets.
